none is inferred from prose (P6, P3).

constraints.statement: Closed judgment contracts, with unchanged subjects: model_validation(OccurrenceModelSubject) decisions [valid,hold,refused,invalid_basis], evidence exact model id/digest, profile basis, typed populations; refusal or invalid basis, unresolved refs retain gap until repaired. occurrence_admission(Occurrence) decisions [admitted,hold,refused,invalid_basis], evidence exact id/digest and resolved pre-existing seed; missing seed retains hold+unresolved_cause, re-entry new complete candidate. event_admission(FrameworkEvent) decisions [admitted,hold,refused,invalid_basis,out_of_scope], evidence id/digest, payload digest, scope authority, source frontier; unresolved scope hold+unresolved_scope, incompatible scope refuses. claim_admission(RelationClaim) decisions [admitted,hold,refused,invalid_basis], evidence id/digest, endpoints, qualifiers, claimant authority, current frontier; unresolved cause or stale frontier holds, re-entry new claim over current frontier. semantic_cut_admission(SemanticAdmissionCut) decisions [admitted,hold,refused,invalid_basis], evidence exact seven-member cut and source/successor frontier equality law; incomplete/inconsistent cut refuses, stale source holds+stale_frontier requiring reconstruction. effect_readiness(EffectSubject) decisions [ready,stale,unauthorized,hold,invalid_basis], evidence exact pre-observation, invocation, operation, grant, territory, invalidation state; stale yields hold+stale_currentness and re-observation, unauthorized yields refusal and no dispatch. transition_evaluation(TransitionSubject) decisions [satisfied,falsified,partial,indeterminate,refused,invalid_basis], evidence exact pre/post observations, outcome, disposition, bounded effect evidence; partial yields partial_effect, indeterminate hold+declared residual, refused refusal. frontier_projection(Projection) decisions [admitted,hold,gap,refused,invalid_basis], evidence exact projection/frontier ids and digests, complete members, basis, precedence law, boundary, residuals; stale holds+stale_frontier, unresolved lineage gap, re-entry new projection. All retain inherited unchanged subject id/digest, evaluator, authority, evidence, provenance and decision coordinate.

grounding.quote:
Each constraint declares zero latitude unless its exact record names a
`latitude_ref`; silence is not latitude.

constraints.statement: Each of identity_dependency_acyclic, occurrence_causation_acyclic and event_causation_acyclic applies to OccurrenceModelSubject/model_validation: falsified→refused+refusal, indeterminate→hold+unresolved_cause. occurrence_seed_complete applies to Occurrence/occurrence_admission with the same mappings. relation_claim_admissible applies to RelationClaim/claim_admission: falsified→refused+refusal, indeterminate→hold+unresolved_cause or stale_frontier. semantic_cut_complete applies to SemanticAdmissionCut/semantic_cut_admission: falsified→refused+refusal, indeterminate→hold+stale_frontier. pre_effect_current applies to EffectSubject/effect_readiness: falsified→stale+hold+stale_currentness, indeterminate→hold+stale_currentness. operation_grant_contains_effect applies there: falsified→unauthorized+refusal, indeterminate→hold+unobserved_subject_state. event_scope_compatible applies to FrameworkEvent/event_admission: falsified→out_of_scope+refusal, indeterminate→hold+unresolved_scope. frontier_complete applies to Projection/frontier_projection: falsified→refused+refusal, indeterminate→hold+stale_frontier. transition_subject_complete applies to TransitionSubject/transition_evaluation: falsified→refused+refusal, indeterminate→indeterminate+unobserved_subject_state. Required residual re-entry: unobserved_subject_state on SubjectBinding acquires bounded observation or retains hold; partial_effect on EffectInvocation acquires post-observation and explicit disposition; unresolved_cause on claim/event acquires authority and evidence or remains unresolved; unresolved_scope on FrameworkEvent declares lawful scope or refuses; competing_lineage on EventFrontier applies authorized frontier_projection judgment; stale_frontier on Projection constructs new exact frontier and projection; stale_currentness on EffectSubject re-observes and re-judges before effect; unobserved_external_mutation on SubjectBinding observes or retains explicit material unknown.
constraints.uncertainty: Residual subject kinds remain those explicitly stated; they are not silently replaced with the constraint's own subject kind.

grounding.quote: A judgment decision is the evaluation's result and a stop is the step's.

constraints.statement: Each refined result maps to exactly one core value for its own named predicate, retaining vocabulary, residual and re-entry. Judgment decisions answer whether the judgment's first listed decision holds for the unchanged subject on the exact basis; stops answer whether the application can reach its declared result on that basis; effect dispositions answer whether the intended effect occurred. A stop does not answer construction availability ('a candidate is available'). Co-emitted values such as stale and hold can map differently because their predicates differ. Where cause changes mapping, cause is part of the refined value, not a new kind; records supply rather than choose that cause.

grounding.quote:
Where the refusal also names a demonstrated violation by what is
  under judgment, it has cause `constraint` below, as AC-007 rules

constraints.statement: refusal(basis) names one or more AC-007 basis conditions and no demonstrated violation by the subject under judgment; a recorded qualifier cause is refuse_invalid_basis. Basis-only coordinate/basis mismatch, basis-relation mismatch, qualifier basis mismatch and cross-basis required cut edge have that cause, including mismatches inside a model/record or an input used as basis. refusal(constraint) is every other refusal: a demonstrated subject violation even alongside basis conditions, or no condition listed for refusal(basis). Its defect is the falsified constraint's counterexample; qualifiers record refuse_missing, refuse_duplicate, refuse_wrong_type or refuse_out_of_scope. A concomitant basis condition is reported separately as invalid_basis and does not change the refusal's cause. Refused decisions inherit the refusal cause. An undeclared event scope remains unresolved while re-entry is open; closing that re-entry without lawful declaration refuses(constraint), retains unresolved_scope and requires a new lawful event candidate. Incomplete seeds, incompatible scopes and defective required edges are defects of the candidate, not automatically defects of the operation's basis. Another operation using that record as basis may have a different predicate and classification.
constraints.uncertainty: AC-007 is referenced as subject law; its complete conditions are outside the supplied source.

grounding.quote: Whether the effect has ended is not part of this cause:

Falsified never licenses treating the effect as absent; indeterminate
never licenses treating it as absent or as complete;

constraints.statement: partial_effect(not_attained) requires admitted effect evidence and bounded post-observation, interpreted under IntendedOutcome's outcome contract and comparison basis, establishing both non-attainment and that no later completion can attain it. Examples include ended-short effects, closed outcome intervals or already-performed damage defeating the outcome; the unreached part is a counterexample. Evidence of the effect's end is not required for that cause; an unestablished end is retained in the residual. Every other partial_effect is undecided: missing bounded observation, possible later completion, apparently met outcome with effect still acting, or lost response without observed counterexample. Lost responses, absent records and an actor context lacking traces establish neither non-attainment nor effect termination. transition_evaluation partial inherits its partial_effect stop's cause. Neither mapped core value records actual mutation or termination; partial_effect residual and re-entry preserve both through every join. Falsified does not mean absent; indeterminate means neither absent nor complete; neither establishes termination. Explicit re-entry precedes any further effect, and an effect whose end is unestablished is reconciled under referenced ACTIVATION recovery before repetition.

conditions: For every traversal under this profile's signature.

grounding.quote: | stop `gap` | invalid_basis |

constraints.statement: Stop mappings: hold→indeterminate; gap→invalid_basis because required reference/lineage resolution remains open; refusal(constraint)→falsified; refusal(basis)→invalid_basis; invalid_basis→invalid_basis; out_of_scope→falsified, emitted only with refusal for a declared scope conflicting with admitting authority; partial_effect(not_attained)→falsified; partial_effect(undecided)→indeterminate. Undeclared scope while re-entry is open yields hold+unresolved_scope, not out_of_scope; closure without the declaration yields refusal(constraint). Decision mappings: each judgment's first listed decision→satisfied; out_of_scope, unauthorized and stale→falsified; hold→indeterminate; gap→invalid_basis; invalid_basis→invalid_basis; transition_evaluation falsified/indeterminate retain their names; partial(not_attained)→falsified; partial(undecided)→indeterminate; refused(constraint)→falsified; refused(basis)→invalid_basis. A missing transition post-observation yields indeterminate+unobserved_subject_state under transition_subject_complete. Mapping does not discard required residuals, counterexamples, qualifier distinctions or re-entry.

exceptions: A refusal naming only a basis mismatch is refusal(basis), not a falsified structural constraint.

grounding.quote:
A required reference
that `model_validation` leaves unresolved, its resolution still open as
AC-007 defines for `gap`, is not refused: it retains `gap` until repaired

constraints.statement: Structural constraints include closed required fields, populations and declared reference domains; exclusion of hidden records, ambiguous refs and unknown record kinds; finite-reference rows, targets, sorts, cardinalities and nested coordinate/witness shape; event kinds, payload sorts/digests and permitted fields; qualifier shape; ProfileRecordRef union/domain membership; exact occurrence edges. Demonstrated violations supply structural counterexamples and refusal(constraint)/refused(constraint), not automatically invalid_basis. A required reference whose resolution remains open retains gap until repaired. A reference evaluated to no target, including a local reference absent from closed populations, is dangling and refuses. Refusal qualifiers retain the particular missing/duplicate/wrong-type/out-of-scope/basis defect independently of the core value.

grounding.quote:
`Sigma_occurrence.FunctorKind` contains exact refs to `F_D`, `F_P` and
`F_H` from `b_ac` and no other functor kind.

constraints.statement: Sigma_occurrence.FunctorKind contains only exact F_D, F_P and F_H references from b_ac. Their imported AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5 laws remain unchanged.
constraints.uncertainty: The imported functor laws are not supplied here.

grounding.quote:
A
retry or a continuation creates a fresh occurrence only when it reapplies
the traversal.

constraints.statement: Occurrence identity binds only pre-admission facts: exact profile basis, pre-existing application identity, traversal identity, functor-kind identity, subject-binding identity, intended-outcome identity, declared lineage inputs and declared identity-dependency inputs. Application traversal/functor fields equal the occurrence's; lineage/dependency populations are those of relation congruence. Post-effect observations, effect evidence, judgments, admitted events, timestamps, admission ordinals and projection results stay outside the seed and may refer back only after their own identities exist. Mirroring relation records are minted after occurrence identity, do not enter its seed, and reproduce its endpoints exactly. Two applications of the same traversal to the same subject are two occurrences. Retry/continuation creates a new occurrence only on traversal reapplication; later controller steps, observations, waits and correlation records do not thereby become occurrences. Each retained bracketed AC-016 application has its own occurrence; an applied composite has an aggregate occurrence; component links do not imply material cause. Required intermediate results, judgments, evidence, authority, provenance and stops remain explicit.
constraints.uncertainty: AC-016 composition requirements are imported, not fully supplied.

grounding.quote:
The directed graph formed by `identity_depends_on` is finite and acyclic.
Every dependency target exists before the dependent identity is minted.

constraints.statement: The identity_depends_on graph is finite and acyclic. Every target exists before its dependent identity is minted; no future result or event enters its own occurrence seed.

conditions: For admission of a relation claim c.

grounding.quote:
Only `j_c.decision = admitted`, `j_e.decision = admitted` and
`j_a.decision = admitted` together admit the complete semantic cut.

constraints.statement: Source-defined admission sequence is c→j_c over unchanged c→candidate e binding c,j_c,F_k→j_e over unchanged e→deterministic r from (c,j_c,e,j_e,basis)→F_k_plus_1→a=(c,j_c,e,j_e,r,F_k,F_k_plus_1)→j_a over unchanged a. Only all three decisions admitted admit the cut. c,j_c,e,j_e,r,a,j_a have distinct identities and authority. Construction does not admit a claim; judgments do not rewrite subjects; events do not inherit candidate authority; materialization cannot change accepted kind, endpoints, qualifiers or basis. j_c/j_e/j_a kinds are claim_admission/event_admission/semantic_cut_admission and bind respective subject ids and sha256(canonical subject bytes). Each has complete inherited context, owner, scope, basis, evaluator, authority, decision, evidence, provenance and decision-time fields. Missing cut judgment, non-admitted decision, wrong subject/digest or cross-basis judgment refuses the cut.
constraints.uncertainty: This sequence is represented as data, not executed.

conditions: For a claim-admission semantic cut.

grounding.quote:
The source frontier must not
already contain `e`, and duplicate frontier members refuse before any set
comparison (P3, P5).

constraints.statement: Admission-event identity binds event kind, payload digest, scope, optional occurrence, exact claim, claim judgment, source frontier, owner and basis; materialized-relation identity binds unchanged claim, claim judgment, event, event judgment and profile basis. frontier_contains(F,e) holds iff e appears once in F.member_event_refs, with no extra/missing event in either representation. Claim admission uses the exact claim-admission URN; claim, event and cut source-frontier refs are identical. All seven cut subjects, all three judgments and the three required relations share the exact profile basis. Source/successor frontiers share projection_basis_ref and precedence_law_ref; their only content difference is e.id added once. Cut refs resolve unchanged records. Required edges are exactly admits_claim(e,c), materializes_relation(e,r), frontier_contains(successor,e), with inherited shape and exact qualifiers; missing, extra, reversed, duplicate or cross-basis required edges refuse. Source cannot already contain e; duplicate members refuse before set comparison. First event needs no fictional predecessor. Re-admitting identical claim, claim judgment, event judgment, source frontier, basis and authority returns the existing byte-equal cut; non-identical collisions refuse_duplicate and mint no rival facts. Pre-admission claim endpoints already exist; generated admission/materialization relations are post-admission, not self-future claims.

conditions: For a relation claim.

grounding.quote:
This atomicity is
semantic; the profile prescribes no storage or transaction mechanism

constraints.statement: One admitted semantic cut contains unchanged claim, its judgment, event and scope and judgment, deterministic materialized relation, exact source frontier and unique successor. Claim/event/cut name the identical source frontier; successor equals it plus exactly the admitted event. Missing, conflicting or inconsistent members refuse the cut. Atomicity is semantic and prescribes no storage or transaction mechanism.

conditions: When corrects_event(new,existing) holds.

grounding.quote: `corrects_event(new, existing)` keeps both immutable events.

constraints.statement: Correction retains both immutable events and changes later projection only through explicit selection law; it never deletes, rewrites or retrospectively re-identifies the corrected fact.

grounding.quote:
A cycle in the untyped union is not a causal cycle unless one
declared causal subgraph itself cycles (P3).

constraints.statement: G_id identity dependency, G_occ_cause occurrence causation and G_evt_cause event causation stay distinct and each is acyclic under its own relation. Cause requires an admitted causal claim under competent authority and evidence. Timestamp, ordinal, adjacency, containment, common subject, shared actor, correlation and arrival order create no cause. Wider typed lineage may lawfully have opposing different-kind edges, such as support and correction; an untyped-union cycle is causal only if a declared causal subgraph itself cycles.

exceptions: An adopting Product may replace exact territory equality only by the explicitly permitted compatible-signature containment relation.

grounding.quote:
Profile construction
and occurrence admission mint no grant (P6).

constraints.statement: Functor kind, traversal, domain operation, executor, actor, grant and invocation are distinct coordinates; F_P/F_D/F_H classification alone neither identifies, authorizes nor executes an operation. Lawful operations require an existing owner-issued matching grant naming subject binding, operation kind and territory. Invocation.operation_ref=operation.id; operation_of_kind target=operation.operation_kind_ref; targets_subject target=operation.subject_binding_ref; authorized_by target=invocation.operation_grant_ref=grant.id. Operation, grant and occurrence share subject binding. Operation kind belongs to grant.allowed_operation_kind_refs. Operation contract equals the referenced OperationKind's contract. Operation territory=invocation territory=grant.allowed_effect_territory_ref. Grant closes over exact kind and contract: matching labels with different contract/target sort, invalidated kind or unresolved kind ref cannot authorize. Nominal kind equality, role labels, executor access and broad workspace access do not satisfy grants.

grounding.quote:
`invokes_effect` exists if and only if a concrete invocation was
dispatched; `unauthorized` or `stale` readiness never dispatches it.

If the pre-observation or the grant has become stale, the effect does
not start;

constraints.statement: Observe the mutable subject under its binding; construct the exact invocation and EffectSubject; readiness judges the unchanged subject immediately before dispatch under declared currentness/invalidation law. ready is the represented dispatch gate. unauthorized or stale never dispatches. Stale observation or grant requires re-observation and a new readiness subject/judgment, or stopping. invokes_effect exists iff a concrete invocation was dispatched. Immutable invocation contains no future disposition; later disposition does not rewrite it. Once effect begins without an established complete disposition, partial_effect stays explicit and bounded post-effect observation is required. No lock or transaction implementation is required.

exceptions: Without any EffectInvocation naming an occurrence, no intended-effect predicate is posed; no_effect is only a record of no attempted domain effect.

grounding.quote:
A refusal records a decision about authority; it does not by itself
establish the absence of a mutation.

constraints.statement: no_effect has no dispatched invocation and records no attempted domain effect. completed_effect binds one dispatched invocation, bounded post-observation and sufficient evidence establishing intended effect and termination. partial_effect binds one dispatched invocation, bounded post-observation/evidence, partial_effect residual and stop, and explicit re-entry before further effect. refused_effect binds a refused invocation attempt, refusal stop and evidence that no mutation began within the material boundary. An authority refusal alone proves no absence: actual or possible unauthorized mutation requires retained invocation, observations and uncertainty, fails refused_effect's evidence condition and follows referenced effect/recovery law. not_effected means intended outcome not attained, not absence of all effects. Where an invocation names an intended effect, mappings for 'the intended effect occurred' are completed_effect→completed→satisfied; partial_effect(not_attained)→not_effected→falsified, retaining performed part and uncertain end; partial_effect(undecided)→completion_unknown→indeterminate; refused_effect→not_effected→falsified; no_effect→not_effected→falsified because none was dispatched. Without a naming invocation, no_effect is not an effect result.

conditions: For a later traversal application when authority is unchanged.

grounding.quote:
A later traversal application observes the then-current
`W` under the stable binding when authority is unchanged (P3, P0).

constraints.statement: W remains the mutable reality carrier; representations cannot replace it. A later application observes then-current W under the stable binding when authority remains unchanged. A new occurrence implies no rollback.

conditions: On each traversal reapplication over the evolving subject.

grounding.quote: Iteration does not mutate an earlier occurrence.

constraints.statement: Reapplication mints a fresh immutable occurrence and never mutates an earlier one. Admitted occurrence/event history is append-only despite repeated changes to the external subject.

grounding.quote:
New events create a new frontier, and a prior projection does not silently
advance.

constraints.statement: EventFrontier binds complete evaluated membership, exact basis and declared precedence law. Projection judgment binds one unchanged Projection id/digest; Projection binds exactly one unchanged frontier. For each profile basis b, scope s and precedence law p there is one empty F_0(b,s,p). Admitting e creates successor members(F) union {e}. Frontier identity binds basis, scope, precedence law, sorted event identities and content digests; Projection identity binds exact frontier, rule, selected relation ids, boundary ids and residual ids. New events produce new frontiers; old projections never silently advance. Latest-only summaries prove no completeness. Competing corrections, unresolved scope, missing causal inputs and stale basis remain residuals/stops under the selected law.

grounding.quote:
`event_for` is present only
when the scope law names one exact occurrence.

constraints.statement: Every event carries declared scope class. event_for exists only when scope law names one exact occurrence. Subject-wide, publication-wide and other occurrence-independent facts remain independent.

grounding.quote: Only Product authority adopts the profile

constraints.statement: The profile grants no semantic, operation, evaluation, admission, decision, correction, continuation or closure authority. Every material operation/judgment resolves an existing owner-issued grant; copying records or adopting the profile transfers none. Only Product authority adopts it. Adoption declares at least exact profile basis, subject and subject-binding interpretation, Product-concept mappings to sorts/relations, operation/actor/executor/admission/projection/decision authorities, event scope/frontier laws, invalidation/re-entry conditions and qualification evidence of no lost Product distinction. Absent/incomplete adoption means available but inactive for that Product.

conditions: Once immutable publication member bytes exist.

grounding.quote:
The list is free of duplicates and sorted by ascending unsigned
UTF-16 code units.

constraints.statement: occurrence_signature_clause_refs is a nonempty duplicate-free list sorted by ascending unsigned UTF-16 code units, containing exactly absolute publication member URIs with fragments #authority-and-adoption, #candidate-judgment-event-and-relation-separation, #causality-and-typed-lineage, #closed-constraint-judgment-residual-and-stop-kinds, #closed-event-kind-population, #closed-relation-families, #closed-semantic-object-sorts, #event-frontier-and-projection, #mutable-subject-effect-relation and #occurrence-identity. These collectively define closed sorts, fields, domains, relations, constraints, judgments, residuals, stops and functor refs. profile_member_sha256 equals publication member digest. The calculus clause resolves exact inherited signature schema/record law in its exact publication. Relative paths, mutable source URIs, missing fragments, duplicates or references outside the two exact publication members refuse the signature.

grounding.quote:
Its spelling establishes
identity, not acceptance or release standing.

constraints.statement: Embedded signature digest equals its RFC 8785 JCS digest. Basis likewise uses JCS, rejecting duplicate object names before canonicalization. Imported AxiomaticCalculusBasis resolves exact RFC 8785 bytes satisfying referenced calculus §8; its calculated identity equals both calculus_basis_identity fields. Manifest digest resolves exact manifest bytes containing calculus member path/digest once; member bytes match; calculus clause URI is that member plus #2-signature. Derivation/publication bases bind the same immutable package but preserve distinct premise/owner versus publication roles. Principle refs are exactly the sorted duplicate-free expansion declared by that calculus member, never a subset or invented list. Every referenced member's digest occurs once in the manifest and each fragment resolves one heading under publication address law. Unresolved basis, mismatched manifest/member, missing/extra principle refs, invented/absent fragments or unbound bytes refuse admission. Profile member obeys the same rules; mutable paths, strategy posts, implementations and consumer mappings substitute for neither basis nor publication identity. release_uri is one absolute immutable stdo://releases/v<version>-rc.<positive-ordinal>/ URI; acceptance is a verdict on that cut, creates no second identity, and is not established by spelling. member_uri is release_uri plus standards/TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md; manifest contains that path/digest exactly once and signature repeats the digest. Kind/version values are exact; digests use lowercase sha256:<64-hex>. Identity preimages are exact JCS values: alternate bytes, newline, object order, duplicate names, non-I-JSON values or implementation-specific serialization cannot acquire the declared identity.
constraints.uncertainty: No instantiated publication basis, manifest or byte-resolution evidence is supplied.

grounding.quote:
Any change to the calculus basis, the signature refs, the closed signature
or the profile member bytes mints a new profile basis.

constraints.statement: Changes to calculus basis, signature refs, closed signature or profile bytes mint a new profile basis. Supersession is an external Product/release judgment; old bases never silently advance. Instances of signature and basis are issued only after member bytes freeze and excluded from the member set whose manifest digest they name. Their member schemas embed neither instance nor instance digest, preventing self-dependent digest preimages.

grounding.quote: - a process, traversal, retry, continuation or closure engine;

constraints.statement: Profile is neither a change to pure a_c/reference-frame law nor mandatory for all symbolic models; neither concrete subject/workspace ontology nor process/traversal/retry/continuation/closure engine; neither event store/log schema/projection implementation/state carrier nor mutation/admission/evaluation/decision authority; neither prospective-frame nor sensor-population profile. It guarantees neither occurrence ownership of every event nor acyclicity of every typed-lineage graph.

conditions: For review and qualification of an adoption/implementation.

grounding.quote: Review and qualification cover at least (P6, P5):

constraints.statement: Review covers at least: exact a_c basis/eight RecordKind_ac populations/closed domains without shadowing; inherited families/direct coordinates/disjoint local-external identities; complete seeds/congruent mirrors/no future results/events; first event without fictional predecessor; distinct candidate/judgment/event/relation/cut/cut-judgment ids with unchanged subject digest; idempotent or refused duplicates; cycles in each identity/causal subgraph; lawful opposing support/correction; closed event kinds/payload/digest/scope/bindings without fabricated event_for; separated functor/traversal/operation-kind/instance/executor/actor/grant/invocation/target/territory; missing/stale/mismatched/out-of-territory grants; all four effect cases; mutable reality carrier; fresh reapplication identities; component/aggregate identities; refusal on stale pre-observation and grant currentness; incomplete cut refusal including missing/non-admitted cut judgment or unequal source frontiers; frontier completeness/staleness/correction selection; no cause from timestamp/ordinal/adjacency/containment/correlation; absent adoption and incomplete-mapping refusal; exact JCS/kind/schema/URI/digest/calculus-address/publication-membership reconstruction. Examples/checkers establish only evaluated claims and acquire no engine or semantic authority.
constraints.uncertainty: The conformance list uses 'refusal' for stale readiness while the detailed law distinguishes stale, hold and stale_currentness.

conditions: For UX work governed by this profile.
exceptions: The narrowly conditioned view-local ephemera allowance is stated separately.

grounding.quote: The view is not a state owner.

constraints.statement: View is a pure projection of typed State; transitions are pure reductions over typed Msg; effects are reducer-described values interpreted at a declared membrane; runtime owns lifecycle and continuation. Stateful mutation in views, two-way binding without action emission and effect handlers acting as controllers violate the profile despite ecosystem convention.

conditions: Product authority adopts the profile for a UX surface and records adoption in product definition, ticket, design module or review.

grounding.quote:
until one of them is taken, the ambiguity is
`blocked` and implementation does not proceed.

constraints.statement: Adopted profile is the surface's sole UX realization authority. Project ADRs may choose stack but cannot weaken process model. Existing code, library convention, screenshots, comments, design history, prototypes and generated artifacts are evidence only. Concrete ambiguity fails closed: satisfy stricter interpretation→resolved; reprice through governing constitutional method to governing-surface owner→escalated; record scoped design-module exemption before implementation→carried with exemption residual. Until an exit is taken, ambiguity is blocked and implementation cannot proceed.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced §15 gives further result definitions outside the supplied sections.

conditions: Instance premises hold where a UX surface is realized under this adopted profile.

grounding.quote:
Its instance
premises hold where a UX surface is realised under this profile; they are
adopted with it and do not follow from the foundations

constraints.statement: F20 imports F2 transitions/steps/configuration, F3 results/combination, F4 work-state/resumption/reuse, F11 change/ambiguity and F13 carriers, and refines F17 software design. Adopted instance premises, not foundational deductions, are: I1 people/systems observe admitted truth and request changes through surfaces; I2 external Product design declares truth/carriers; I3 stacks differ and tolerate view state/continuation/effects; I4 uncontrolled data seams; I5 short iterations can make per-change proof cost exceed correction. Ten authored consequence rows preserve ownership: (1) P6/P1+F2/F11+I1/I2 require admitted carriers and blocking absent carriers; profile owns five carrier kinds/binding requirements, Product design actual contracts. (2) P0/P1/P4a+F2+I3 support typed transitions; choosing TEA and ephemera test is profile policy. (3) P0/P5+F2 require declared effects; profile owns membrane/handler rules refining DESIGN_MODULE, project interpreter. (4) P4b/P6+F4 require replayable recorded behavior and executable proof before closure; profile owns test/six proof contents, project design module proof surface. (5) P3/P1/P6+I4 require shared types and runtime validation; profile makes six seams mandatory, project schema mechanism. (6) P2/P6+I1 require public-capability accessibility declarations and recorded internal-debug exemption; profile owns five declarations, WCAG AA is only recommended web default, project may strengthen. (7) P2/P1+I3 permit stack freedom, never rankings; project owns choices, profile owns compliance tests and stricter fail-closed handling. (8) P6+F11+I3 require admitted adoption/one authority and ambiguity outcomes. (9) P6/P4b+F4/F11/F13+I5 require authorized scoped scaffold exemption with retirement, no production by accumulation, visible bounded payable proof escrow and classification of every close finding; profile owns default-governance/escrow/trigger choices, TICKETS generic escrow and six close classifications, SPEC_METHOD sprint boundary. (10) P5/P6+F3 require four predicate-specific refinements, one core mapping per value without conflating review/replay/closure/carrier results. Pillar associations by row are respectively {4,5,9},{3,4},{4,8},{6,8,9},{2,3,4},{1,9},{4,8},{1,7,9},{1,9},{3,9}. P0 is recovered; P1/P2/P3/P4a/P6 independent; P5 derives from P0/P6 with open-world premise; P4b derives from P0/P2 with non-reacquirable step facts. No policy choice is presented as foundational derivation. Adoption-opening steps, failure patterns and review questions apply these consequences; each clause names its requiring principle.
constraints.uncertainty: Detailed five accessibility declarations, default-governance conditions, escrow inventories, classifications and four result refinements are referenced but not enumerated in the supplied source.

conditions: When consumers enter the foundation-to-law rows.

grounding.quote:
